decisions.reason: The formwork profile system builds directly on the firm's core formwork knowledge, so in-house R&D can keep refining it, although it has not been seen on the website since 2020.

Automated concrete distribution flow control fits the firm's automation strategy and engineering competence, which makes the early results easy to interpret and improve, despite its absence from the website.

The shuttering magnet line with several models extends established magnetic formwork know-how, but its missing web presence and the earlier withdrawal of the related strips make consolidation possible.

This magnetic formwork component is close to the existing offer and easy to assimilate, but it overlaps with the withdrawn strips and has not been visible since 2020, so it is a candidate for consolidation.

This component was only ever mentioned on the website, duplicates other magnetic formwork components and has disappeared from view, so its resources are better used in the core system business and in automation development.
